result.summary: Found 2 issues: one critical content/localization bug and one minor layout issue.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' appears to be an untranslated localization key instead of a human-readable string (e.g., 'Popular near you'). This is a clear i18n/localization failure exposed to end users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' has a proper translation entry for the current locale (English), so users see meaningful text like 'Popular near you' instead of the raw key.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is partially clipped, with the restaurant name truncated mid-word. While horizontal scrolling is implied, there is no visual affordance (e.g., a partial peek or scroll indicator) to clearly communicate this to users.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator or ensure the card peek is more intentional and consistent to signal horizontal scrollability to users.
